name: Big Caring Group Bhd
summary: Big Caring Group Bhd, through its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmacy retail and manufacturing company in Malaysia. The company's business comprises two segments: Retail, including sale of pharmaceutical, healthcare, beauty, general merchandise, and other related products through its network of retail outlets, e-commerce platforms, and corporate sales channels; and Others including manufacturing, importing, marketing, distributing, and wholesaling of healthcare, pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products as well as the provision of physiotherapy, tele-consultation and other healthcare-related services.
